ABQ.zh: 1930 年代阿尔伯克基只有西梅萨与奥克斯纳德两座私人机场；现机场 1937 年动工、1939 年启用，当时建有两座铺装跑道、一座普韦布洛风格航站楼（Ernest Blumenthal 设计）与一座为波音 307 准备的大型机库。1940 年机场被指定为阿尔伯克基陆军航空基地（今柯特兰空军基地的前身），至今仍与基地共用跑道。
ABQ.en: Albuquerque's municipal airport opened in 1939 with two paved runways and its Pueblo-style terminal; a year later it became an Army air base, and it still shares its runways with what is now Kirtland Air Force Base.

ABI.zh: 机场由阿比林市自有自营，起降以通用航空与军事训练为主，同时是阿比林地区的商业航空与空运枢纽。航司更替频繁：Allegiant 2006–2007 年的拉斯维加斯航线因客座率低停飞，Continental Connection 也在 2008 年 10 月以油价为由退出休斯敦航线；目前定期航班由 American Eagle 独家执飞，每日 7 班支线喷气机往返达拉斯-沃思堡。
ABI.en: The city-owned field is dominated by general aviation and military training, with American Eagle as its sole scheduled carrier today — seven regional-jet flights a day to Dallas–Fort Worth. Earlier services came and went: Allegiant left in 2007 and Continental Connection pulled out of Houston in 2008.

ACV.zh: 这座机场由美国海军在二战期间修建，最初用于测试飞机的除雾系统；1947 年 12 月，西南航空（Southwest Airways）的一架 DC-3 在此完成了航空史上早期著名的盲降飞行。机场位于尤里卡以北 24 公里的麦金利维尔，服务整个洪堡县，并是美国联邦指定的国际到达口岸。
ACV.en: Built by the U.S. Navy during World War II to test aircraft de-fogging systems, the field saw a Southwest Airways DC-3 make an early landmark blind landing in December 1947. It sits in McKinleyville, 24 km north of Eureka, and is a federally designated port of entry.

ADM.zh: 机场又称阿德莫尔工业空港（Ardmore Industrial Airpark），为通用航空机场，其历史可追溯到 1945 年的陆军航空场（Ardmore AAF）。场地距阿德莫尔市中心东北约 16 公里，占地 2,503 英亩，有两条跑道（13/31 长 2,201 米，规划延长至 2,743 米）与 FAA 值守的塔台。
ADM.en: Also known as Ardmore Industrial Airpark, the general-aviation field traces back to the 1945 Army airfield (Ardmore AAF). It spreads over 2,503 acres north-east of Ardmore with two runways and an FAA-staffed tower.

AEP.zh: 机场位于布宜诺斯艾利斯帕勒莫区、距市中心约 2 公里，以阿根廷飞行员豪尔赫·纽伯里命名，由 Aeropuertos Argentina 2000 运营。它原本只经营国内航班和飞往乌拉圭的国际航班，2010 年 3 月起新增巴西、智利与巴拉圭航线；2009 年旅客量约 649 万人次。军用区是政要登机之处（总统专机 Tango 01 平时驻于 El Palomar），2010 年底机场曾因跑道大修关闭数周。
AEP.en: Named after Argentine aviator Jorge Newbery, the airport sits in Palermo about 2 km from the centre of Buenos Aires and is run by Aeropuertos Argentina 2000. Long domestic-only plus Uruguay, it added Brazil, Chile and Paraguay flights in March 2010; its military apron is where the country's leaders board, and a major runway rebuild closed it for weeks in late 2010.

ALM.zh: 机场旧称阿拉莫戈多市立机场，现由市政府所有、面向公众开放，定期航班依靠美国「基本航空服务」（EAS）补贴，由 New Mexico Airlines 执飞埃尔帕索与阿尔伯克基。2008 年 11 月，机场用 10 万美元补助安装了一套 8 千瓦太阳能阵列以削减电费。场地位于白沙地区，海拔 1,280 米，两条跑道中 16/34 为土质道面。
ALM.en: Formerly Alamogordo Municipal Airport, the city-owned field keeps scheduled service alive through the Essential Air Service subsidy, flown by New Mexico Airlines to El Paso and Albuquerque. In November 2008 it installed an 8 kW solar array with a $100,000 state grant; its second runway, 16/34, is dirt.

AMD.zh: 机场以印度政治家、首任副总理萨达尔·瓦拉巴伊·帕特尔命名，服务艾哈迈达巴德与甘地讷格尔两城，是印度第八繁忙的机场（日均约 250 架次），也是多家印度航司的重点城市。机场占地 1,124 英亩、跑道长 3,600 米，现有国内、国际、辅助与货运四座航站楼。
AMD.en: Named after India's first deputy prime minister, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the airport serves Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar as the country's eighth busiest field — some 250 movements a day. It spans 1,124 acres with a 3,600 m runway and four terminals (domestic, international, secondary and cargo).

AYT.zh: 安塔利亚机场距市区约 13 公里，是土耳其地中海沿岸度假区的主要门户：2008 年旅客量约 1,880 万人次，其中国际旅客超过 1,620 万。1 号国际航站楼 1996 年动工、1998 年 4 月启用，1999 年起由 Fraport 与 Bayındır 集团的合资公司运营；2 号国际航站楼由 Çelebi 运营。
AYT.en: About 13 km from the city, Antalya is the gateway to Turkey's Mediterranean resorts — 18.8 million passengers in 2008, over 16.2 million of them international. International Terminal 1 opened in April 1998 and has been run by a Fraport/Bayındır joint venture since 1999; Terminal 2 is operated by Çelebi.

ADE.zh: 机场的前身是英国皇家空军霍尔马克萨尔基地（RAF Khormaksar），1917 年启用、1967 年撤编，1970–80 年代又曾作为苏联空军的驻地。现有塔台与三层航站楼 1999 年动工、2001 年启用，融入了伊斯兰建筑元素；机场同时是也门空军基地，规模在也门仅次于萨那国际机场。
ADE.en: The field began as RAF Khormaksar — opened in 1917 and closed as an RAF station in 1967 — and hosted a Soviet Air Force station through the 1970s and 80s. Its present tower and three-storey terminal, built from 1999 and opened in 2001, carry Islamic design elements; it is also a Yemeni Air Force base and Yemen's second largest airport after Sana'a.

AHN.zh: 机场以佐治亚州第一位飞行员本·T·埃普斯命名——1917 年正是他开办了这座机场。此后航空公司几经更替：Air Midwest 执飞的 US Airways Express 每日两班夏洛特航线在 2008 年 5 月停航，GeorgiaSkies 接飞亚特兰大与梅肯，短暂运营的 Wings Air 数月即告结业。
AHN.en: Named for Ben T. Epps, Georgia's first aviator, who opened the field in 1917. Airline service has been choppy: the twice-daily US Airways Express link to Charlotte (flown by Air Midwest) ended in May 2008, GeorgiaSkies took over the Atlanta and Macon routes, and a short-lived Wings Air folded within months.

ALA.zh: 机场始建于 1935 年，1990 年前隶属哈萨克民航局，1991 年改组为「阿拉木图机场」，1994 年改制为股份公司并更名阿拉木图国际机场。图-144 超音速客机 1975 年 12 月的首个定期货运航班由莫斯科飞抵此地，1977 年 11 月起投入客运，该机型 1978 年 6 月 1 日的最后一次定期客运航班也执飞这条航线。1998 年跑道重建后，机场取得 II 类运行能力与国际机场资质。
ALA.en: Opened in 1935, the field became Alma-Ata Airport in 1991 and today's joint-stock Almaty International in 1994. The Tu-144's first scheduled freight run — Moscow to Alma-Ata — landed here in December 1975; passenger service began in November 1977, and the supersonic airliner's final scheduled flight was on this route on 1 June 1978. A 1998 runway rebuild brought CAT II capability and international status.

ALY.zh: 机场位于亚历山大东南约 7 公里（旧称 El Nouzha），长期承担这座城市的民航业务，2009 年旅客量约 114 万人次，埃及航空是最大承运人。受跑道长度限制，最大只能起降 A320、波音 737-800 级别的机型；随着博格埃尔阿拉伯机场启用，本机场计划在 2010 年底停止商业运营、航班整体转移。
ALY.en: Seven kilometres south-east of the city, Alexandria's old El Nouzha field carried its commercial traffic for decades — 1.14 million passengers in 2009, with EgyptAir the largest operator — but its short runways capped aircraft at A320/737-class, and it was set to hand commercial service to Borg El Arab Airport by the end of 2010.

AND.zh: 机场自启用以来持续扩建：2007 年一条跑道延长了约 300 米，可以保障更大型的支线喷气机起降。它没有定期商业航线，也没有塔台，却已是南卡罗来纳州上州最繁忙的机场之一。
AND.en: The field has grown steadily since opening — one runway gained 300 m in 2007, clearing the way for larger regional jets. It has no scheduled airline service and no control tower, yet ranks among the busiest airports in upstate South Carolina.

ANR.zh: 安特卫普的机场建设始于 1921 年，在飞行员扬·奥利斯莱格斯等人的推动下动工；萨贝纳航空（Sabena）自 1924 年起在此运营客运航班。二战期间这里被盟军编为 B-70 前进着陆场（Advanced Landing Ground）。
ANR.en: Work on a proper Antwerp airport began in 1921, pushed by pioneer aviator Jan Olieslagers and others, and Sabena flew passenger services from 1924. In World War II the field served as Allied Advanced Landing Ground B-70.

ARC.zh: 机场属维尼蒂部落政府所有，只有一条 1,372 米的砾石跑道 2/20。2005 年全年 1,627 架次起降中有近九成是空中出租车（air taxi），这是这座阿拉斯加原住民村落与外界往来的主要方式。
ARC.en: Owned by the Venetie Tribal Government, the field has a single 1,372 m gravel runway. Nearly 90% of its 1,627 operations in 2005 were air taxis — the village's main link to the outside world.

ARK.zh: 机场 2004 年旅客量约 8.7 万人次，此后启动扩建，包括延长跑道与新建航站楼，以承接阿鲁沙作为游猎门户不断增长的客流。
ARK.en: The field handled about 87,000 passengers in 2004; an expansion adding runway length and new terminal buildings is under way as Arusha's safari traffic grows.

ASB.zh: 机场 1994 年启用，以土库曼斯坦首任总统萨帕尔穆拉特·尼亚佐夫命名，主跑道长 3,800 米并支持精密进近。它是土库曼斯坦两座国际机场之一，距首都约 10 公里。
ASB.en: Opened in 1994 and named after Turkmenistan's first president, the airport sits about 10 km north-west of Ashgabat with a 3,800 m precision-approach runway — one of the country's two international airports.

ASJ.zh: 机场位于奄美大岛，距奄美市约 22 公里：原名「奄美大岛机场」，后来改用现在更简短的名字。岛上的航线以连接鹿儿岛与东京、大阪为主。
ASJ.en: On Amami Ōshima about 22 km from the city, the field was long called Amami Oshima Airport before shortening to its present name; its routes mainly link the island with Kagoshima, Tokyo and Osaka.

AUG.zh: 机场由缅因州所有、奥古斯塔市管理运营，以通用航空为主，定期航班依靠「基本航空服务」补贴维持。场地占地 350 英亩，两条沥青跑道中最长的 17/35 为 1,524 米。
AUG.en: Owned by the State of Maine but managed by the city of Augusta, the field is mostly general aviation with a single Essential Air Service carrier. It covers 350 acres, the longest of its two runways measuring 1,524 m.

AVV.zh: 阿瓦隆是墨尔本四座机场中客流第二大的一个，距吉朗 23 公里、墨尔本市区 55 公里：Jetstar 与 Sharp Airlines 在此运营定期航班，澳航把重型维修基地设在这里。机场自 2008 年 5 月起提供常态化空管服务，并且是两年一度的澳大利亚国际航展举办地。
AVV.en: Melbourne's second-busiest airport, 23 km from Geelong and 55 km south-west of the city, hosts Jetstar and Sharp Airlines and Qantas heavy maintenance. Regular air traffic control arrived in May 2008, and the field stages the biennial Australian International Airshow.

AUH.zh: 机场是阿提哈德航空的枢纽，2008 年前后是全球增长最快的机场之一（当年一季度客流同比增长约 34%），此后启动了总额约 250 亿迪拉姆（约 68 亿美元）的扩建。到 2012 年 1 月，已有 53 家航司在此开通飞往 49 个国家、85 个目的地的航线。
AUH.en: Etihad's hub and one of the world's fastest-growing airports around 2008 (+34% passengers in that year's first quarter), Abu Dhabi has since pushed through an AED 25 billion (US$6.8 billion) expansion — by January 2012, 53 airlines served 85 destinations in 49 countries.

ABD.zh: 二战期间，阿巴丹机场是「租借法案」援苏飞机的重要中转枢纽：1942 年 5 月起，美国陆军航空队航空技术服务司令部与道格拉斯公司在此设厂，第 17 航空补给大队负责组装和试飞新到货的飞机，再经德黑兰梅赫拉巴德机场交付苏联。机场当时被空运司令部北非联队编为「3 号站」，航线连通德黑兰、伊拉克哈巴尼亚与巴林。
ABD.en: In World War II Abadan was a major logistics hub for Lend-Lease aircraft bound for the Soviet Union: from May 1942 a USAAF and Douglas plant here assembled and flight-tested newly arrived aircraft before they flew on to Tehran for handover. The Air Transport Command numbered it Station #3, linking Tehran, RAF Habbaniya and Bahrain.

ACY.zh: 机场是军民合用机场，距大西洋城市中心约 17 公里，由南泽西交通局所有并运营。这里驻有新泽西空军国民警卫队第 177 战斗机联队（装备 F-16C/D）以及美国海岸警卫队的大西洋城航空站。
ACY.en: A joint civil-military field about 17 km north-west of Atlantic City, owned and operated by the South Jersey Transportation Authority. It hosts the New Jersey Air National Guard's 177th Fighter Wing (F-16C/Ds) and the U.S. Coast Guard's Atlantic City air station.

AVL.zh: 机场由阿什维尔市所有，位于弗莱彻镇、距市区约 14 公里；2009 年旅客量首次超过 58 万人次，同比增长 4.1%。场地 900 英亩，只有一条 2,439 米的跑道 16/34，起降中以通用航空与空中出租车为主。
AVL.en: Owned by the City of Asheville and set in the town of Fletcher 14 km south of the city, the field passed 580,000 passengers in 2009 (+4.1%) on a single 2,439 m runway, with general aviation and air taxis making up most movements.

AQJ.zh: 机场位于亚喀巴北郊的工业区附近，由皇家之翼（Royal Wings）运营，跑道 3,000 米并配备 I 类仪表着陆系统。它的位置颇为特别：方圆约 24 公里内就有埃及、沙特阿拉伯与以色列三国。
AQJ.en: Set beside the industrial estate on Aqaba's northern edge and operated by Royal Wings, the field has a 3,000 m runway with CAT I ILS — in a spot where Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Israel all lie within roughly 24 km.

AXT.zh: 机场由秋田县运营，位于秋田站东南约 14 公里，单条跑道 2,500 米，沥青与混凝土道面。它是秋田县民出行与冬季观光客流的主要空中通道。
AXT.en: Operated by Akita Prefecture about 14 km south-east of Akita Station, the field has a single 2,500 m asphalt-concrete runway and is the prefecture's principal air link.

ABR.zh: 机场由阿伯丁市所有，属市政公共机场：起降以通用航空为主，同时由一家商业航司维持定期航线，是南达科他州东北部的主要航空门户。
ABR.en: A city-owned public field east of downtown Aberdeen, dominated by general aviation but kept on the scheduled map by a single commercial carrier — the main air gateway for north-eastern South Dakota.

ABS.zh: 机场紧邻阿布辛贝神庙景区，主要服务往返这一世界遗产的旅客。2009 年旅客量为 449,157 人次，比 2008 年下降约 29%。
ABS.en: Serving the travellers who come to the Abu Simbel temples, the field handled 449,157 passengers in 2009 — down 29.2% on 2008.

AHB.zh: 机场海拔 2,090 米，是沙特阿拉伯地势最高的机场之一，航线以国内城市为主，国际航点仅有开罗与萨那两地。
AHB.en: At 2,090 m above sea level, Abha is among Saudi Arabia's highest airports; its network is mostly domestic, with Cairo and Sana'a the only international destinations.

ADK.zh: 机场由阿拉斯加州交通与公共设施部（DOT&PF）所有，两条跑道长 2,374 米与 2,318 米。阿达克岛在冷战时期是重要的海军基地，如今岛上的定期航班由这支跑道系统支撑。
ADK.en: Owned by Alaska's Department of Transportation and Public Facilities, the field keeps two runways of 2,374 m and 2,318 m — the scheduled lifeline for an island that was a major Cold War naval base.

BBU.zh: 这里的历史可以追溯到 1909 年——法国飞行先驱路易·布莱里奥在伯尼亚萨一带完成了当地最早的飞行，1912 年罗马尼亚第一所飞行学校也在此开办。它因此被视为东欧连续运营时间最长的机场之一，也是世界上最古老的机场之一；1920 年起这里还成为罗马尼亚第一家航空公司的总部所在。
BBU.en: The story starts in 1909, when French aviation pioneer Louis Blériot flew here at Băneasa; Romania's first flight school opened on the field in 1912. That makes it the oldest continuously operating airport in Eastern Europe and among the five oldest in the world — and from 1920 the home of Romania's first airline.

AXU.zh: 机场距阿克苏姆市区约 5.5 公里，以埃塞俄比亚皇帝约翰尼斯四世（1872–1889 年在位）命名，正式名称即「约翰尼斯四世皇帝机场」。城名与机场名也常转写为 Aksum。
AXU.en: Five and a half kilometres east of the city, the field is formally named after Emperor Yohannes IV of Ethiopia (r. 1872–1889); both city and airport also appear transliterated as Aksum.

YLT.zh: 机场由加拿大国防部运营，隶属加拿大武装力量阿勒特站：1950 年这里先建起气象站，1957 年开始建设至今仍在使用的军事设施。按纬度计算，阿勒特机场是世界上最北的机场。
YLT.en: Run by Canada's Department of National Defence as part of CFS Alert, the site began with a weather station in 1950 and military construction in 1957. By latitude it is the northernmost airport in the world.

SDN.zh: 机场 1975 年启用，坐落在 Nordfjord 与 Gloppefjord 两座峡湾之间半岛的根部，由挪威机场集团 Avinor 运营。Widerøe 是这里唯一的航司，以 Dash 8 按公共服务义务（PSO）合同执飞。
SDN.en: Opened in 1975 on the neck of a peninsula between the Nordfjord and Gloppefjord, Sandane is run by Avinor with Widerøe as its sole operator, flying Dash 8s on public service obligation routes.

MOL.zh: 机场 1972 年启用，此后航线长期以奥斯陆、卑尔根与特隆赫姆为主；2007 年旅客量约 40.3 万人次。
MOL.en: Open since 1972, Molde's services have mainly linked Oslo, Bergen and Trondheim; it handled some 403,000 terminal passengers in 2007.

XJD.zh: 乌代德是一座军用机场（空军基地），位于多哈以西，由卡塔尔空军所有，美国空军、英国皇家空军、澳大利亚皇家空军与卡塔尔空军共同使用。
XJD.en: Al Udeid is a military air base west of Doha, owned by the Qatari Air Force and used jointly by the U.S. Air Force, the Royal Air Force, the Royal Australian Air Force and Qatar's own service.

SPI.zh: 机场由斯普林菲尔德机场管理局所有，场内驻扎着伊利诺伊州空军国民警卫队第 183 战斗机联队（Capital Airport Air National Guard Station，占地 91 英亩）。
SPI.en: Owned by the Springfield Airport Authority, the field hosts the Illinois Air National Guard's 183d Fighter Wing at Capital Airport Air National Guard Station, a 91-acre enclave.

SCU.zh: 这座机场以螺旋桨支线航班为主，也起降喷气机；每周约 20 班国际航班，多数由古巴本国航司执飞。教皇约翰·保罗二世 1998 年访问古巴时，最后一程正是从这里往返哈瓦那。
SCU.en: Primarily a turboprop field that also takes jets, Santiago sees about twenty international flights a week, mostly by Cuban carriers. Pope John Paul II flew through here on his final visit to Cuba in 1998.

AYQ.zh: 机场坐落在澳洲中部，年平均旅客吞吐约 40 万人次，是前往乌鲁鲁（艾尔斯岩）的主要门户。航站楼为定期航班服务，最大可保障澳航的波音 737-800 起降。
AYQ.en: In the middle of Australia, the field sees about 400,000 passenger movements a year as the gateway to Uluru. Its single scheduled-flight terminal takes aircraft up to Qantas' Boeing 737-800s.

LFK.zh: 机场位于拉夫金市中心西南约 13 公里，占地 385 英亩，两条沥青跑道（7/25 长 1,645 米）。2008 年全年 18,500 架次起降中有 97% 为通用航空。
LFK.en: Thirteen kilometres south-west of downtown Lufkin, the field covers 385 acres with two asphalt runways; 97% of its 18,500 operations in 2008 were general aviation.

HUU.zh: 机场是瓦努科地区最重要的机场，由政府民航部门运营；目前由 LC Busre 独家执飞，每日一班往返利马，可衔接秘鲁国内外航线，此外还起降大量包机与私人航班。
HUU.en: The Huánuco region's principal airport is run by the civil government, with LC Busre operating a single daily service to Lima (and connections beyond) alongside plentiful charter and private traffic.
HUU.sourceTitle: Alferez Fap D F Fernandini Airport

IXA.zh: 机场由印度机场管理局（AAI）管理，距特里普拉邦首府阿加尔塔拉约 9 公里；它是印度东北部仅次于古瓦哈提的第二繁忙机场，2010–2011 年度在全印 50 个主要机场中排名第 22 位。
IXA.en: Administered by the Airports Authority of India about 9 km from Agartala, the field is the second busiest in Northeast India after Guwahati — 22nd among India's 50 major airports in 2010–11.

SCL.zh: 机场位于圣地亚哥西北约 15 公里，是智利最大的航空设施、全国最繁忙的国际机场，也常被称为「新普达韦尔机场」（Nuevo Pudahuel）。
SCL.en: Fifteen kilometres north-west of downtown Santiago, Arturo Merino Benítez is Chile's largest aviation facility and its busiest international airport, also known as Nuevo Pudahuel.

TTQ.zh: 机场主要服务托尔图格罗国家公园一带，定期航班由 Nature Air 与 Sansa 执飞，多经 Barra del Colorado 中转圣何塞。
TTQ.en: Serving the Tortuguero national-park area, the strip's scheduled flights are flown by Nature Air and Sansa, mostly routing to San José via Barra del Colorado.

YYW.zh: 机场由安大略省政府运营，位于阿姆斯特朗东南约 8 公里，是安大略西北部小型社区航空网络的一环。
YYW.en: Operated by the Government of Ontario about 8 km south-east of Armstrong, the field is part of the small-community air network of north-western Ontario.
